text:
[RDSC.6a.2.4] Each `ServiceKwarg.default_value` is the canonical text of
the value the service receives when a call omits the kwarg ([LADP.8.5.1],
[LADP.8.5.2]), in the storage type of the kwarg's declared type. The compiler
must write it, for each declared type a `default` may take ([LGRA.23.2]), as
follows:

| Declared type | `default_value` | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `Int` | the integer in decimal, `-` first when negative | `255`, `-3` |
| `Float` | the Float's canonical text ([LDET.3.2.7]), from an `Int` literal too | `1.5`; `2.0` for `default 2` |
| `String` | the value in double quotes, each `"` written `\"` and each `\` written `\\` | `"hello"` |
| `Bool` | `true` or `false` | `true` |
| a unit symbol | the quantity expressed in that unit: in decimal where the unit's dimension declares `storage int64` ([LUNI.7.2]), else the Float's canonical text | `90` for `90 s` on an `s` kwarg; `2` for `120 s` on a `min` kwarg; `-10.0` for `-10_celsius` on a `celsius` kwarg |
| a dimension or scalar-group name ([LUNI.7.1]) | the quantity in the dimension's base unit, written as for a unit symbol | `263.15` for `-10_celsius` on a `temperature` kwarg; `90000000000` for `90 s` on a `time` kwarg |

A reader of the manifest needs no unit table: the text is the number the
service would be called with. `default_value` is empty when `has_default` is
false.
